title: StockSmart Customer Request for a New Consigned Bin Taking Over a VendPoint Item
content:
## StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — new consigned bin for an item moved out of a VendPoint machine

**Rule.** A customer's own written request for a new consigned bin that takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its VendPoint machines carries the fill-to level the StockSmart fill-to schedule for such bins sets for that bin, and such a bin is consigned only on a program whose tier allows consigned bins; on any other tier no fill-to level is set under that schedule.

The request is the customer's own act. It adds one bin to one StockSmart program, names the item the bin will hold, says whether that item is non-catalog special stock, and states the bin's fill-to level. The bin it creates is a consigned bin: Corbett-owned stock in the customer's storeroom, billed on consumption.

### Filing the request: `submit_vended_item_bin_request_0334ff8e`

This is a customer-side tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it to the customer, and the customer themselves runs it to file the request; the agent does not file it on the customer's behalf.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `vmi_program_id` | the reference number of the customer's StockSmart program the bin is added to, as shown by the StockSmart program lookup | identifier, copied as shown |
| `bin_label` | the storeroom location label the customer gives for the new bin | text, copied character for character as the customer says it, with no reformatting |
| `sku` | the Corbett item number the bin will hold, as shown on the customer's VendPoint selection or vend records | text, every digit preserved |
| `special_stock` | whether the item is a non-catalog special item Corbett stocks only for this customer, as flagged on its VendPoint selection | `true` or `false` (`false` for a regular Corbett catalog item) |
| `max_qty` | the fill-to level of the new bin | a whole number of units of the item, 1 or more |

### What one filing books

One filing books a single new-bin entry on the program's bin history, effective today: the bin label, the item, the special-stock flag and the fill-to level. The entry is booked as a consigned bin, flagged consigned, not flagged critical, and with a reorder point of 0, because the request names no reorder point. It carries a request reference of the form VBR-NNNNNN.

### Receipt

On success the tool returns a receipt with `status` "recorded", the reference number of the new bin entry (`vmi_bin_id`), the request reference (`change_reference`, format VBR-NNNNNN), `bin_label`, `sku`, `consigned` (always true), `min_qty` (always 0 on this request), `max_qty` in whole units, and `event_date`, the effective date in the form YYYY-MM-DD. No other outcome is defined for this tool.

### Basis questions

**Does a request on a tier without consigned bins carry a fill-to level under the schedule?** No. Such a bin is consigned only on a tier that allows consigned bins, and on any other tier no fill-to level is set under the schedule.

**Who chooses the bin label?** The customer; it is copied exactly as given.
